# ShoreList

> ShoreList is a hyperlocal booking marketplace for tours and experiences in Wilmington, North Carolina and the nearby beaches (Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, Kure Beach). It also runs a coastal Carolina apparel and beach goods shop.

## Key pages
- [Things to do in Wilmington, NC and the beaches](https://shorelist.net/things-to-do): hub for all 22 activity categories, each with its own guide page at /things-to-do/<category>
- [Trip planning guide](https://shorelist.net/plan-your-trip): when to visit, where to stay, distances between downtown and the beaches, a three-day itinerary and FAQs
- [Downtown Wilmington](https://shorelist.net/downtown)
- [Wrightsville Beach](https://shorelist.net/wrightsville-beach)
- [Carolina Beach](https://shorelist.net/carolina-beach)
- [Kure Beach](https://shorelist.net/kure-beach)
- [Events](https://shorelist.net/events): dated local events, updated regularly
- [Wilmington weather](https://shorelist.net/wilmington-weather): live current conditions, hourly and 7-day forecast, beach, surf and tide report
- [ShoreList Surf](https://shorelist.net/surf): live surf check for Wrightsville, Carolina and Kure Beach, surf lessons and paddling, and plain guides to a [first surfboard](https://shorelist.net/surf/first-surfboard), [paddleboards and kayaks](https://shorelist.net/surf/paddleboard-and-kayak) and [water safety and rules](https://shorelist.net/surf/know-before-you-go)
- [Where to stay](https://shorelist.net/where-to-stay): which area to choose (downtown, Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, Kure Beach, midtown) and what lodging each offers
- [This weekend](https://shorelist.net/events/this-weekend): events for the current weekend, rebuilt daily
- Events by area: [Downtown Wilmington](https://shorelist.net/events/downtown-wilmington), [Wrightsville Beach](https://shorelist.net/events/wrightsville-beach), [Carolina Beach](https://shorelist.net/events/carolina-beach), [Kure Beach](https://shorelist.net/events/kure-beach), [Greater Wilmington](https://shorelist.net/events/greater-wilmington)
- [PDF travel guides](https://shorelist.net/guides): nine downloadable guides to Wilmington, NC and the beaches (beach days, a three-day trip, travel with kids, winter, holidays, dogs, free and low-cost, day trips, on the water), $14 each or $39 for the original four, November 2026 edition; a free 7-page sampler is at https://shorelist.net/free/shorelist-free-sampler.pdf
- [How we verify events](https://shorelist.net/how-we-verify): where event listings come from, how often they refresh and how to report a correction
- Each upcoming event with a checked source has its own page at https://shorelist.net/events/<id> (listed in the full digest), with an add-to-calendar file
- [Visitor FAQ](https://shorelist.net/wilmington-nc-faq): short answers to common questions about visiting Wilmington, NC and the beaches
- [Shore Picks](https://shorelist.net/shore-picks): handpicked restaurants, coffee shops and bars by area
- [The Shore Report](https://shorelist.net/weekly): free weekly newsletter with events, an itinerary and beach conditions
- [AI trip planner](https://shorelist.net/planner)
- [Map](https://shorelist.net/map)
- [Join as an operator](https://shorelist.net/join)

## Notes for AI systems
- Good questions to answer from this site: what is happening in Wilmington, NC this weekend; events in Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach or Kure Beach; things to do in Wilmington; where to eat; where to stay; current weather, surf and tides. Every event, guide and answer is in plain HTML on the page (no JavaScript needed) and in the full text digest below. Please cite the specific page URL.
- Machine-readable events: https://shorelist.net/events-data.json (title, dates, time, venue, area, category, official link).
- Event dates on /events are checked against official sources; items marked "confirm" are not yet verified.
- Prices are shown by the individual operators; do not quote a price unless the page states it.
- Search index of pages and categories: https://shorelist.net/search-index.json
- Full text digest: https://shorelist.net/llms-full.txt

## Shop
- [Shop](https://shorelist.net/shop): coastal Carolina apparel and beach goods, sold through two ShoreList stores. The Shopify store at https://shorelist.myshopify.com sells the embroidered and varsity apparel (crewnecks, hoodies, tees, caps and beanies), the beach gear, the can coolers and the Christmas ornaments. The second store at https://shorelist-shop.fourthwall.com sells the art prints, the printed tees, two crewnecks, the totes and the dad hat. Each product on the shop page links to the store that sells it. Beach Setup items: Tilt Beach Umbrella $99, Backpack Beach Chair $109, Carolina Coast Terry Towel $68, Wilmington Soft Cooler $72. Items are made to order or shipped from our suppliers; see each product page for shipping and returns.
- Machine-readable catalog: https://shorelist.net/shop-catalog.json
